exposure: Glycemic qualification rate (GQR) calculated by fingerstick blood glucose (BG) monitoring
Different frequencies of BG monitoring for GQR calculation (twice or three times per day)
cohort: 311 singleton pregnant women diagnosed with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) whose fingerstick blood glucose data were collected during their second and third trimesters.
finding: Worse blood glucose control (lower GQR) in women with GDM was significantly associated with a higher risk of cesarean section, neonatal hypoglycemia, and composite adverse pregnancy outcomes, with a GQR ≥ 80% recommended for better outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with worse blood glucose control (lower GQR) had a significantly higher risk of cesarean section (tertile 1 aOR = 2.029, 1.128-3.648).
